headline: Thanksgiving week is a cozy-content week: soft-launch the holiday menu with the "My Moon My Man" sound (still climbing fast), film a turkey-shaped pastry board before Thursday, and use Mariah's "It's time" to flip the shop into holiday mode.

upcoming.name: "My Moon My Man" soft launch
upcoming.signal: Tokchart (Nov 16, 2026): first used Oct 27, about 375K videos, +100,400 new videos in a day (+12% on the day before), #4 on the worldwide sound chart. About 32% of its videos are from the US. It is also #1 on New Engen's TikTok trends list (updated Nov 13, 2026).
upcoming.whatItIs: A dreamy, romantic cover used for "soft launches": subtle teasers that show a corner of something special without the full reveal, like intertwined hands or two coffee orders on a counter.
upcoming.coffeeShopIdea: Soft-launch the holiday menu: a sleeve of a new cup, a close-up of a house-made syrup bottle, or two drinks side by side on the counter, then reveal the full menu on the next post. Also works as a "perfect pairing" clip of a latte and a pastry from our local baker.

upcoming.name: Mariah's "It's time" holiday kickoff
upcoming.signal: #3 on New Engen's TikTok trends list (updated Nov 13, 2026), which notes coffee shops bringing holiday drinks back to the menu as a core use of the sound.
upcoming.whatItIs: A quick before-and-after: something still plain or autumn-y, then a cut on "It's time" to the festive version.
upcoming.coffeeShopIdea: The shop flips to holiday mode: bare counter, then lights, garland, and the holiday syrups lined up. Or the first holiday drink ordered of the season. Add text like "It's November... you know what that means." The audio is Mariah's voice, so check it's available to business accounts or use an approved holiday track.

upcoming.name: Turkey charcuterie boards (pastry version)
upcoming.signal: #2 on New Engen's TikTok trends list (updated Nov 13, 2026). Seasonal, so it peaks right up to Thanksgiving on Nov 26 and then drops fast.
upcoming.whatItIs: A satisfying overhead build of a board fanned into turkey tail feathers, with the finished turkey saved for the last seconds. Viewers save these as plans for their own table.
upcoming.coffeeShopIdea: Build a turkey out of mini pastries, cookies, and fruit from our local baker, with a coffee-milk or latte beside it. Film overhead, sped up. Offer it as a pre-order or a Friendsgiving treat tray.

upcoming.name: Chipmunks dance (staff group of three)
upcoming.signal: #4 on New Engen's TikTok trends list (updated Nov 13, 2026) and described as spreading fast. The routine is short enough to learn in an afternoon. Video counts weren't published, so check the sound in the app.
upcoming.whatItIs: Groups of three hit a goofy routine of jumps, kicks, and spins to a sped-up, chipmunk-voiced remix. The more everyone commits, the better it lands.
upcoming.coffeeShopIdea: Three baristas in aprons do the routine in front of the espresso bar before opening. Quick, funny, and shows off the team. Listen to the full sound and confirm it's business-safe before posting.

upcoming.name: "5 stages of being..."
upcoming.signal: Newest entry (Nov 13, 2026) on Later's weekly Instagram Reels trend list.
upcoming.whatItIs: Five clips and five moods, from confident and hyped to fully overwhelmed, titled "5 stages of being..." with whatever fits your world.
upcoming.coffeeShopIdea: "5 stages of being a barista on Wednesday before Thanksgiving": calm, first rush, pie-order panic, oat milk running low, then the final cup and a happy sigh. Keep it warm and funny.

links.label: Trend sound on Instagram (listen before using)

upcoming.name: Appointment timestamps ("one drink" timestamps)
upcoming.signal: Added to Later's weekly Instagram Reels trend list on Nov 13, 2026, as a spin on the day-in-the-life timestamp format.
upcoming.whatItIs: Timestamp the journey of a single visit, from walking in to walking out, instead of a whole day.
upcoming.coffeeShopIdea: One customer's visit to Bucket & the Bean: 9:02 walks in, 9:04 picks a syrup, 9:06 first sip, 9:20 chats with the featured artist, 9:35 walks out with beans to go. A calm behind-the-scenes look at the space.

links.label: Trend sound on Instagram (listen before using)

upcoming.name: "Go, Go, Go" (format only)
upcoming.signal: #7 on New Engen's TikTok trends list (updated Nov 13, 2026). New Engen specifically cites "coffee pickup" as an example situation.
upcoming.whatItIs: Lip-sync a frantic "go, go, go" clip over on-screen text describing a moment that calls for instant action.
upcoming.coffeeShopIdea: Text like "when they call your name and it's the new holiday latte" or "POV: the pastry case just got refilled." Use a clean sound from TikTok's Commercial Music Library or Meta's sound collection rather than the original clip.

upcoming.name: "I just wanna..." lifestyle wish list (format only)
upcoming.signal: On Later's list as "I just wanna" (Nov 6, 2026) and #12 on New Engen's TikTok list (Nov 13, 2026), so it is still circulating a few weeks after it started.
upcoming.whatItIs: "I just wanna..." over lifestyle B-roll, revealing how the creator would spend a windfall, or the jobs and passions behind their day.
upcoming.coffeeShopIdea: "I just wanna roast the beans, pour the latte art, and hang a new artist's work" over clips of exactly that. We aren't confirming the original song's lyrics are family-friendly, so use a clean sound from TikTok's Commercial Music Library or Meta's sound collection.

tailEnd.name: "Toggle on," "Recharged" 1% to 100%, and "Small text zoom"
tailEnd.whyItsFading: All three were added to Later's list on Oct 30 and have since been replaced by Nov 6 and Nov 13 entries. They're evergreen enough to reuse for a menu tease or a morning-coffee glow-up, but they're no longer fresh. (The sound most paired with "Small text zoom" comes from a song with explicit lyrics, so skip it.)

tailEnd.name: Vlog timestamps and "My reaction"
tailEnd.whyItsFading: On Later's list since Oct 23, about three and a half weeks old. The timestamp idea lives on in the newer "Appointment timestamps" format.

tailEnd.name: "Be OK" (cheerful dance, relatable confession)
tailEnd.whyItsFading: It was a new pick on New Engen's Nov 2 list but didn't make the Nov 13 list, so its moment has passed. The "relatable cafe mishap" idea still works with other sounds.

tailEnd.name: #musteatinmycity ("Lunch in my city")
tailEnd.whyItsFading: It topped the hashtag chart around Nov 1-2, but it isn't on Tokchart's top 10 now (Nov 16, 2026). The format of a hyper-local "first sip" recommendation is evergreen, so keep using it without the hashtag push.

tailEnd.name: "Refuse to be limited by a single niche," "Money can't buy happiness, but...," and "Taking one for the team"
tailEnd.whyItsFading: On Later's list since Oct 16 to Oct 23, so three to four weeks old. Evergreen if you want them: "...it can buy a maple latte," or the barista who taste-tests every holiday syrup "for the team."

tailEnd.name: Fan transition, "Take that chance," and outfit formats
tailEnd.whyItsFading: On Later's list since Oct 9, over five weeks old. They're mostly fashion formats and don't translate well to a coffee counter.

tailEnd.name: Halloween and October formats (Ramalama, "Halloween - cute horror song," October sounds)
tailEnd.whyItsFading: Halloween was Oct 31 and these sounds are gone from the top of the charts. Save the ideas for next October.

tailEnd.name: Yogurt coffee
tailEnd.whyItsFading: Peaked around March 2026. It still works as a funny taste test, but not as its own trend.

music.title: my moon my man (Finneas cover)
music.artist: Finneas (cover of Feist), posted by niki
music.stats: First used Oct 27, 2026. About 375K videos, +100,400 new videos in the last day (+12%), #4 on Tokchart's worldwide chart (Nov 16, 2026). About 32% of videos are from the US.
music.vibe: Soft, dreamy, romantic. Gentle enough to make simple footage feel cinematic.
music.coffeeShopUse: Holiday menu soft launch, two drinks side by side, or a latte-and-pastry pairing. Check the lyrics and in-app availability before posting from a business account.

music.title: Chopin Nocturne No. 2 Piano Mono
music.stats: About 7.4M videos, with +100,000 new in the last day and #5 on Tokchart's US chart (Nov 16, 2026). First used in 2020, so it's a long-running sound enjoying a new surge. About 16% of videos are from the US.
music.vibe: Calm, elegant solo piano with no lyrics. It fits almost anything.
music.coffeeShopUse: Slow, cozy B-roll: steam off a fresh cup, latte pours, snow or rain outside the window, the art wall in warm light.

music.title: It's Time (Mariah's holiday kickoff audio)
music.stats: #3 on New Engen's TikTok trends list (updated Nov 13, 2026). Video counts weren't published, so check the sound page in the app.
music.coffeeShopUse: Flip the shop to holiday mode, or the first holiday drink of the season. Check availability for business accounts or recreate the moment with an approved holiday track.

music.title: The Blue Danube Waltz
music.stats: The sound behind the "Every girl for absolutely no reason" format on Later's Reels list (added Nov 6, 2026).
music.vibe: Light, classical waltz with no lyrics. Playful and elegant.
music.coffeeShopUse: A fun "for absolutely no reason" moment: a barista suddenly in a festive apron, a pastry-case reveal, or a spontaneous latte-art flourish.

music.title: Mix (the "Toggle on" sound)
music.stats: Tied to the "Toggle on" trend added to Later's Reels list on Oct 30, 2026. It hasn't appeared in newer updates.
music.vibe: Build-up and reveal. It's a creator-made mix, so listen all the way through before posting.
music.coffeeShopUse: Still usable for a holiday menu reveal or announcing this month's featured artist, but it's aging.

music.title: Be OK
music.stats: Was #4 on New Engen's Nov 2, 2026 list but isn't on the Nov 13 list.
music.coffeeShopUse: Fine for a barista swaying behind the counter with funny on-screen text, but the trend has moved on.

calendar.name: National Espresso Day
calendar.idea: Go behind the bar: show how we dial in the espresso each morning, or use "Appointment timestamps" to follow one shot from grind to first sip.

calendar.name: Thanksgiving
calendar.idea: Share what the team is thankful for: our regulars, our baker, our local partners. Post any holiday-hours changes a few days ahead, and film the turkey pastry board before Thursday.

calendar.name: Black Friday
calendar.idea: Skip the sale hype and show gift ideas instead: a bag of locally roasted beans, loose-leaf teas, and a bottle of house-made syrup as a gift set.

calendar.name: Small Business Saturday
calendar.idea: Spotlight our local business partners and this month's featured artist. Soft-launch a Small Business Saturday special with the "My Moon My Man" sound.

calendar.name: Giving Tuesday
calendar.idea: Show a community give-back: a pastry or coffee for a local cause, or a shout-out to a local nonprofit we support. Keep it genuine and low-key.

calendar.name: National Cookie Day
calendar.idea: A barista taste-tests every cookie from our local baker "for the team," then finishes with a happy face rating.

calendar.name: National Hot Cocoa Day
calendar.idea: A cozy close-up of a house-made syrup cocoa with toppings, set to a calm piano sound like the Chopin Nocturne.

calendar.name: First day of winter
calendar.idea: A cold-morning-to-warm-cup moment: frosty window, steaming mug. A good "1% to 100%" energy recharge clip.

howToSpotEarly: A sound that's climbing the chart fast but is still under about 100K videos is early. That's the sweet spot.
Over about 1M videos with slowing daily growth means it's late. Only use it if the idea is great.
On Later's weekly Reels list, the newest dated entries are the freshest. Anything three or more weeks old is aging.
Check Tokchart's US daily chart for sounds and hashtags with big day-over-day jumps.
In the Instagram app, an upward arrow next to a sound means it's trending. Tap it to see how many Reels use it.
Business accounts: pick sounds from TikTok's Commercial Music Library or Meta's royalty-free sound collection, and copy the format rather than the exact audio.
Always listen to the full song and look up the lyrics before using a sound. Some trending clips come from songs that aren't family-friendly.
